scope: Overlay and tooltip lifecycle group: OverlayPortal descriptors, RawTooltip descriptors, and the RawTooltipController attachment. Surfaces live in the existing retained transient registry; dismissal is a controlled callback contract, never silent state mutation. Rich-message semantic fallback, follower paint/hit/semantics agreement, and builder-content overlay semantics notes are recorded in plan-15.md. Native-host popup availability stays separate from neutral correctness. This ledger covers only this family; it does not claim whole-codebase completeness.
